Subject: Redwood architecture deep-dive: scheduling & pre-read pack

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We’d like to schedule a focused architecture deep-dive to cover runtime routing, KV/cache behavior, and operational runbooks so your infra leads have clear handoffs. Proposed slots (PT):

- Monday 2026-12-20, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Tuesday 2026-12-21, 08:30–09:45 AM PT

Agenda (draft):
- 10m introductions & success criteria
- 25m serving runtime overview (latency/cost controls)
- 20m routing & fallback policy walkthrough
- 15m topology & network constraints (diagram)
- 15m data-retention & compliance notes + Q&A

Attached: Redwood_Arch_Playbook_draft.pdf (playbook with proposed slides) and topology-diagram-v2.png. Also a runbook stub: session_runbook.odt (internal).

Can you confirm which slot works and whether you want us to expand the data-retention section (e.g., example S3 lifecycle/purge windows, KMS footprint)? Also please indicate any additional attendees on your side.

Action items for internal team: please review the attached playbook and flag anything that must be covered in the 75-min slot. Laura — can you check the compliance bullets; Jonas — please look at the topology diagram and suggest any clarifications.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — the Monday slot (Dec 20, 10:00 PT) works for our infra leads (Bob Turner and myself). Two quick asks before we lock: 

1) Expand the data-retention section to call out regional retention differences (we are multi-region EU/US) and how the KV cache is evicted vs. persisted.
2) Can we get a separate, higher-resolution network diagram that includes ingress egress ports and VPC peerings? The topology image helps but we need ports/ACLs for our security review.

If you can add those to the pre-read and resend, we can triage questions ahead of time.

Also please include any expected actions for our SRE (e.g., firewall rules, NAT/GW changes) in the runbook.

Best,
Alice
CTO, NimbleAI
